checks.name: laboratory exposes no activation, deletion or source-write operation
real diary name is refused before any database open
arbitrary destination name is refused before any database open
browser can enumerate disposable databases for absent-fixture assertions
missing source is refused without creating source or destination
unexpected source schema is refused without damaging its marker or creating destination
a higher source version is refused without a downgrade or target creation
unsupported structured-clone type fails before a sidecar is created
a staged sidecar is copied while the old v1 connection remains open
source was read only and the old v1 opener still sees its original value
water, food text, binary bytes, list, null and integer key survive raw copying
restaging an occupied sidecar is refused without overwriting it
an injected abort follows request success and reports no commit
aborted transaction leaves both sidecar records and metadata empty; source is unchanged
retry into the still-empty aborted sidecar succeeds
two concurrent stagers cannot overwrite one another
a subsequent old-source write is detected and does not alter the staged sidecar
sidecar tampering is detected without changing the source
all audited laboratory source transactions were readonly
cooperating laboratory lock can be held
synthetic candidate UI committed one fictional food and 250 ml
real synthetic-candidate Hive data stages without any source write transaction
staged candidate values preserve the exact synthetic water and food payload
a later synthetic application write makes the staged snapshot mismatch
every loaded candidate main script matches the sealed synthetic build

risks.name: raw staging includes a fake private marker and is not a privacy-filtered export
two committed writes returning to the same value are invisible to a snapshot comparison
a nonparticipating old writer commits while a laboratory Web Lock is held
the candidate sidecar also contains the fake private marker
sidecar staging does not repair the existing candidate v2 rollback incompatibility

limitations: Lab-only research, NOT a release, migration, rollback mechanism, or real backup.
The v1 source and old writer are raw IndexedDB fixtures, not the exact archived +14 application.
The candidate portion uses the separately named synthetic v2 database and a disposable browser profile.
A match between sequential reads cannot fence nonparticipating writers and can miss ABA changes or future writes.
Raw staging copies private fields; it is not a privacy-filtered export and must never be used on real data.
Unknown structured-clone types are rejected; byte values and a few selected synthetic values do not cover all Hive data.
No production cutover, all record types, real diary, cloud, auth, multiple devices, real quota, power failure, Safari/iOS, or Android was tested.
